# Baseline strengths (generated by `tools/measure_baselines.py`)

Seat-balanced. Ties split the win. Planner budgets: MCTS = 60 simulations / rollout depth 40, SearchLite = 250 nodes, Search = 1500 nodes. These budgets, not a clock, set the strength (this run allows 120 s per move). Under the official rules an entry gets 0.1 s per decision while the bundled baselines keep their own 1 s, which every baseline move fits, so these are the opponents an entry meets.
